6600.desc: Jet-black fruit whose taste changes each bite. Unstable, so hard to cook with.

6601.desc: A seed that looks like a plain stone. Odorless, it sinks: only cracking tells.

6602.desc: Tiny brown seed. Dried well, it makes fragrant tea.

6603.desc: Brittle seed that crumbles to dust at a touch. Be careful.

6604.desc: Plant fruit so hard it chips teeth raw. Boiled, it is soft and tasty.

6605.desc: Rare fruit with a glossy color. It smells wonderful, but can't be eaten.

6606.desc: Very hard, tough ore that is easy to work with heat.

6607.desc: Mineral rich in lead. Easy to work and very useful.

6608.desc: Crystal as cold as ice. Perfectly clear; light through it makes a rainbow.

6609.desc: Looks aside, this ore melts easily and is easy to work. Crumbles unless burned.

6610.desc: Rare ore seldom mined at any real size. It sparkles beautifully.

6611.desc: A strange crystal that blends with all materials and boosts their traits.

6612.desc: Bug named for its finder. Its shell is very hard; used in many crafted goods.

6613.desc: A dragonfly with wings that shimmer like heat haze. Easy to lose if you look away.

6614.desc: Insect named for two lights in its shell that glow and fade softly.

6615.desc: Stem-mimicking grasshopper. Hard to find. Only caught by chance when netting bugs.

6616.desc: Insect named for its diamond-shaped wings seen from above.

6617.desc: Rare insect that raises young with belly nectar. Males gather the nectar.

6618.desc: Herb gathered only by day in sunlight. Its leaves are taut and full of life.

6619.desc: Herb gathered only at night. Blooms in a dripping shape. The plant itself is small.

6620.desc: Phantom ore rarely obtained. Pearl-like in color, it gleams more when polished.

6621.desc: A fish that never stays put, found in many lands.

6622.desc: A fish seen only in set seasons by region. Stubborn.

6623.desc: Plant with beautiful bright red flowers. Looks dainty, but very sturdy and hard.

6624.desc: A softly glowing insect. Best not to look at it.

6625.desc: A transparent crystal. Weak and brittle, so often powdered for crafting.

6626.desc: Clear blue rock evoking the blue sea. Looking at it seems to calm you.

6627.desc: A dainty mushroom shaped like a princess in white. Grows only in special spots.

6628.desc: A mushroom taking long years to grow. It is treated as a precious item.

6629.desc: A top-grade edible fish. Delicious boiled, grilled or raw.

6630.desc: Rare giant fish seen from above like an anchor, found only in very cold lands.

6631.desc: Fist-sized ice lump rarely mined. Highly pure, so it doesn't melt easily.

6632.desc: Smooth and rich in talc. Sometimes used in cosmetics. (Settlement Item)

6633.desc: Very hard. Can only be eaten by a special dealer's skill. (Settlement Item)

6634.desc: Rare phantom flower. Beastfolk sometimes have it; where it grows is unknown.

6635.desc: Very rare tears shed only by certain wyverns. (Settlement Item)

6636.desc: Dung used to mark territory. Also makes good fuel. (Settlement Item)

6637.desc: Big pearl of a strange hue. Highly valued as a gem. (Settlement Item)

6638.desc: Ammo for the large survey ship's anti-monster weapon. (Supply Only)

6639.desc: Decoration for attack and protection skills.

6640.desc: G Rank decoration for attack and protection skills.

6641.desc: G Rank decoration for attack and protection skills.

6643.desc: Bone from a superb Yian Kut-Ku. It has both power and grace.

6644.desc: An eerie Yian Kut-Ku beak. It makes an unsettling sound when struck.

6645.desc: Ear from a bewitching Yian Kut-Ku. It has a smooth touch.

6646.desc: Shell from a superb Daimyo Hermitaur. It has both power and grace.

6647.desc: Daimyo Hermitaur claw built to block attacks. As firm as a solid bulwark.

6648.desc: Two feelers from Daimyo Hermitaur's head. Tough, yet they bend well.

6649.desc: Frozen Sea Beast bone. Its unique shape allows life on both land and in water.

6650.desc: Metallic Pokaradon claws. Iron-hard, they ring shrilly when clapped together.

6651.desc: Two thick, sturdy tusks of a Frozen Sea Beast. A strong weapon to guard the herd.

6652.desc: Ice crystal formed when a Pokaradon dies. It never melts.

6653.desc: Pokaradon tail. It swims in the sea at times, so the tail is fin-shaped.

6654.desc: Thick fur of Pokaradon. The thick fur is vital to life in cold regions.

6655.desc: Crystal made in a monster. A source of life force; used in much gear.
